# Source Han Sans

The generated LVGL fonts in `boards/atk-dnesp32s3/fonts` are derived from
Adobe's Source Han Sans CN Regular. Source Han Sans is distributed under the
SIL Open Font License 1.1; the complete license is included in this directory.

- Upstream: <https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-han-sans>
- Source font: `SubsetOTF/CN/SourceHanSansCN-Regular.otf`
- Source font SHA-256:
  `e2bc8a2e7f37474b774fff8db758681ece40bb6947a90d571bce9dd60671a8e4`
- Generator: `tools/generate-fonts.sh`
